newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - St. Paul Bancorp downgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - St. Paul Bancorp downgraded.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities Inc said Tuesday it downgraded St. Paul Bancorp Inc for the intermediate term based on the current stock price.
-- A recent advance in the price brought the company's shares close to EVEREN's revised target of $30, EVEREN said.
-- EVEREN said its newly long-term price target stands at $33 a share, which it said continues to imply an attractive return for investors with a longer term perspective.
-- The 1997 earnings estimate is $1.95 a share and the estimate for 1998 remains $2.10, EVEREN said.
-- St. Paul Bancorp is a bank holding company.
-- Its shares were off 13/32 Tuesday at 28-1/4.
